text:
Maria (platform): quick gut-check — do we want a single canonical span name for LLM calls or keep them under http.server and add llm.* attrs?
Akash (eng-runtime): prefer a dedicated name, e.g. `llm.inference` or `llm.request`. keeps traces readable in Tempo.
Jamie (eng-ml): +1 for `llm.inference`. most dashboards will filter by model, tokens, cache. span name should indicate intent not transport.
Sophia (eng-platform): worried about breaking dashboards that rely on http span names. can we keep `http.server` as parent and emit a child `llm.inference`?
Akash (eng-runtime): that works for edge cases. runtime currently instruments at the http layer, but we can emit an inner span after routing decision. cheap change in collector pipeline.
Leo (eng-sre): important: sampling rules. high-traffic customers could blow storage if we emit full attr sets always. propose token counts + cache hits as numeric attrs, but never raw prompt text.
Jamie (eng-ml): agree on no raw prompts. we can include `llm.prompt_id` (sha256) and `llm.prompt_hash_v1` as an attr for eval correlation.
Maria (platform): here's a proposal snippet for attrs and naming:
```
span.name = "llm.inference"
attributes:
  service.name = "redwood-inference"
  llm.model.name = "gptx-13b"
  llm.model.variant = "q4_0"
  llm.input_tokens = 28
  llm.output_tokens = 112
  llm.kv_cache.hits = 3
  llm.kv_cache.misses = 0
  llm.batch.size = 1
  llm.prompt_id = "sha256:..."
  telemetry.pipeline_version = "v2"
```
Sophia (eng-platform): nice. add `llm.fallback_model` when we route to a cheaper model on failure. also `llm.routing_policy` (latency|cost|region).
Akash (eng-runtime): + add `llm.quality_mode` (strict|best_effort) to indicate if we accept quantization/approximation. helps correlating latencies to quality regressions.
Leo (eng-sre): retention and exporter routing note: raw spans with token counts -> hot retention 30d in Tempo/observability; aggregated counters (per model/day) -> long-term (365d) in metrics store. we need to redact or hash any identifiers before long-term export.
Maria (platform): telemetry-bot ran a sim of storage delta. for 1M requests/day, adding full llm attrs increases raw span bytes ~30%. so we must implement attr sampling and exporter filters by customer tier.
telemetry-bot: simulation summary: top-line delta = +28% storage, estimated monthly cost increase = $3.6k for staging cluster.
Jamie (eng-ml): suggested sampling rules: always keep 100% of errors and latencies > 95th pct, 10% of normal success spans, and 1% detailed spans for each customer for drift detection.
Akash (eng-runtime): we can implement sampling in the collector with attribute-based rules: `match: llm.model.name == "*" -> sample_rate = X` and route detailed spans to hot path exporter (Tempo) and light attrs to cold path (GCS/BigQuery).
Sophia (eng-platform): small ask: console dashboards expect token-level cost columns. confirm we will expose `llm.input_tokens` and `llm.output_tokens` as integers in the metrics pipeline (not just traces).
Maria (platform): yes, emit token sums as metrics via OTLP metrics exporter. metrics pipeline will aggregate per-route/model/hour and feed the billing/cost view.
Leo (eng-sre): security reminder: do not store customer-provided PII in attributes. add an attribute allowlist and an attribute-scrubber step in collector.
Akash (eng-runtime): here's a proposed collector filter config (pseudo):
```yaml
processors:
  attributes/llm_filter:
    actions:
      - key: prompt_text
        action: delete
      - key: user_email
        action: delete
      - key: prompt_id
        action: tag  # keep hashed id
exporters:
  tempo: ...  # hot path
  bigquery: ... # cold path aggregated
service:
  pipelines:
    traces/llm_detailed:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [llm_filter, sampling_rule]
      exporters: [tempo]
    traces/llm_aggregated:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [aggregate_attrs]
      exporters: [bigquery]
```
Jamie (eng-ml): love the split. also: add `llm.kv_cache.evictions` maybe useful for cache sizing.
Maria (platform): decision checklist: span name = `llm.inference`, keep http span as parent, attrs per proposal, hashing for prompt_id, strict no-prompt-text policy, sampling rules + hot/cold exporter split, metrics emission for tokens.
Sophia (eng-platform): can someone open an RFC with the final attr list and collector examples? I'd like to drive the console changes from that.
Akash (eng-runtime): I'll draft the RFC this week and include the exporter config and sampling rules.
Leo (eng-sre): I'll add retention/alerts section and storage impact notes.
Maria (platform): thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @Sophia for dashboards, @Jamie for eval correlation, @Leo for alerts. :thumbsup:
